title: 美国二季度GDP仅增1.5% 消费与通胀数据分化
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The numbers aren't really all that good this morning.
segments.zh: 今早的数据其实并不乐观。

segments.en: We haven't had a lot of numbers like this in a while. And they are backward looking because it's first quarter or second quarter GDP.
segments.zh: 我们很久没看到这样的数据了，而且这是第一或第二季度的GDP，属于滞后指标。

segments.en: You got to go back to April, May and June comes in at one and a half percent.
segments.zh: 回顾四月到六月，GDP增速为1.5%。

segments.en: That's after a 2.1 percent rise in the first quarter and it's below the 2 percent that was anticipated.
segments.zh: 此前第一季度增长2.1%，低于预期的2%。

segments.en: Now personal consumption was higher for the quarter, 3.2 percent than in the first quarter, 0.5 percent.
segments.zh: 本季度个人消费支出增长3.2%，高于第一季度的0.5%。

segments.en: But it started off strong in the first quarter and then was revised down.
segments.zh: 但第一季度开局强劲，随后被下修。

segments.en: The latest numbers on income and spending, which go into this second quarter report are from June, incomes up just 2.10s after 7.10s the prior month, personal spending up 3.10s.
segments.zh: 最新收入与支出数据（来自六月）显示，收入环比仅增0.2%，前月为0.7%；个人支出环比增0.3%。

segments.en: It was up 9.10s in the month of May.
segments.zh: 五月个人支出环比增长0.9%。

segments.en: So when you average that out, it's still not a good number in terms of the consumer.
segments.zh: 因此平均来看，消费端数据依然不佳。

segments.en: We'll have to see whether or not that continues to be revised.
segments.zh: 我们需要观察后续是否会继续修正。

segments.en: The PCE price index, everybody's been kind of waiting on that although they can figure it out.
segments.zh: PCE价格指数，大家都在等这个数据，尽管他们也能推算出来。

segments.en: Down a 10th of 8 percent, as forecast, it was up half a percent in the month of May on a year over year basis that leaves us at 3.7 percent.
segments.zh: 环比下降0.1%，符合预期，5月同比上涨0.5%，年率降至3.7%。

segments.en: That's down from 4.1 percent. The core PCE number is at an increase of one 10th of 8 percent, much lower than the 3.10s we had in May.
segments.zh: 低于之前的4.1%。核心PCE环比上涨0.1%，远低于5月的0.3%。

segments.en: And a year over year basis, we fall from 3.4 to 3.3 percent.
